title: Lesson 21 - I've Had This Cough for a Week

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: What would you like help with today?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: I've had this cough for a week. It started last Monday.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: No. It was dry for the first three days, but it's been worse since Friday.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: When does it usually get worse?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: It gets worse when I lie down at night. Warm drinks seem to make my throat feel better for a little while.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: I haven't had a fever. I checked twice yesterday and once this morning.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Have you noticed any shortness of breath or chest pain?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: No, I haven't noticed either of those.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Are you taking any medicines or supplements?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Just my usual daily vitamin. I haven't taken anything specifically for the cough.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Is there anything else you want the clinician to know?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: That's everything I've noticed: one week, worse since Friday, mostly at night, no fever, and no trouble breathing.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Thank you. I'll add that to your appointment note. If your symptoms become severe or you develop an emergency warning sign, seek urgent help rather than waiting for this appointment.
